protocol: D-000 new cycle, turn 1 of 3; refute not confirm; one owner-recording entry for DR-004 under adopted D-054 / D-057; own cycle, not D-058
summary: The subject held frozen and every attack fails but one. The D-057 pin list is satisfied in full — disposition and both verdicts as complete paths with sha256s and 'ACCEPT 0/0' each — and the Route A remainder is provably complete, an exact three-item match against the disposition's own whatRemainsOwedOnRouteA which I compared by string equality. All four artifact digests, file 08, and all five cited commits verify, and D-054, D-057 and D-048 are each still ADOPTED and unsuperseded. The one objection is the COORD pin: the entry cites 6f5557df, which is COORD as of commit 4dedc17 — the commit that added a duplicate D-058 register entry. That duplicate was dropped at 1b94ad5, so live COORD is 658c4d15 and the pinned state is one the corpus has deliberately reverted as erroneous. Worth saying plainly: the duplicate-D-058 risk I recorded as a note last cycle did materialize, and the coordinator caught and corrected it itself.

objections.claim: The cited COORD digest does not match live bytes, and the state it pins is one that was committed in error and then deliberately reverted.
evidence: The entry cites COORD 6f5557df175ed6873d40581a538ccf2449d6df04fbfb320c9884ad8ac466b365. Live COORD measures 658c4d1501c9bf6065a2020e33498ae40e18e86c2f9b467d1f2171e20fe0a1c2.

I traced the divergence rather than reporting it as generic drift. COORD at commit 21f0945, the genuine D-058 adoption, is 658c4d15…. COORD at commit 4dedc17 is 6f5557df… — the cited value. 4dedc17 is titled 'D-058: owner-record DR-002 preview Route B disposition' and changed only COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md, adding a second D-058 register entry.
Commit 1b94ad5, 'D-058: drop duplicate COORD register entry', removed it. Live COORD now contains exactly one '## D-058' heading, and its digest is back to 658c4d15….
So the cited pin is not merely stale. It fixes the transient duplicated-register state, which the corpus has since judged erroneous and reverted.
objections.whyOnlyShouldFix: COORD is environmental provenance here, not a governing input for this decision. Every pin the decision actually rests on is correct: the D-054 path, sha256 and commit; the D-057, D-048 and D-050 commits; the disposition and both verdicts. None of those moved, and nothing substantive turns on the COORD value. The entry also carries its own instruction, 'If a cited file moves, re-measure.'
objections.whyItStillBlocksConsent: The dispatch names 'cited digests do not match live bytes' as an attack axis and this is a literal hit. An adopted D-059 citing 6f5557df would enshrine, as its measured environment, a register state that exists in no live branch and was reverted as a mistake — which is exactly the kind of link a later reader cannot reconcile.

whatIVerified: Subject digest at start and end: 0e6f44b0a8a807b3cfd9166a404a0a4dfe3808ac0f5815ccff2f7325b69cf9b5, three measurements at start and again at end, equal to the dispatched frozen digest. The dispatch made motion an OBJECT condition and it does not arise.

The attack 'D-057 pin list incomplete (paths, both verdict paths, full Route-A remainder)' fails on all three limbs. The Authority and dependency pins section gives the disposition as a full path with sha256 and each verdict as a full path with sha256, and the measured-inputs table repeats both with 'ACCEPT 0/0'. This is the same complete form I consented to on D-058, and it is the repair of the finding I raised twice on the earlier drafts.

The Route A remainder is complete, tested rather than read. I compared the entry's three items against the disposition's whatRemainsOwedOnRouteA field by string equality: three items each, exact match, same order — the exact eight-bullet packet inserted through the V1 process with retained proof, custody, joins, and status update; successor honesty on section31 v4 advisories S31V4-01, S31V4-02, S31V4-CX-A1, S31V4-CX-A2 (D-045); and DR-002 AC-4 still names this packet.

That third item matters and is correctly carried: it is the cross-row link to DR-002's AC-4, so recording DR-004's preview disposition does not quietly detach the packet obligation that DR-002 also depends on.

The attack 'treats section31 v4 as the Phase-1A packet' fails. Clause 3 states 'section31 v4 stays the binding instrument, not the packet', which matches what I graded at the v4 review and what D-045 records, and the Route A remainder keeps the packet owed.
All four cited artifact digests match live bytes: the D-054 user amendment, the DR-004 v2 disposition, and both v2 verdicts. file 08 also matches.

All five cited commits resolve at full hash to the expected decisions: 29670ed… D-054, 33597e8… D-057, aa75926… D-047/D-048, 88764fa… D-049/D-050, and 21f0945 D-058. That last one is notable — the entry cites 21f0945, the genuine D-058 adoption, rather than 4dedc17, the commit that duplicated the register entry. The provenance claim 'D-058 already adopted at 21f0945 for DR-002' is correct.

D-057's live-adoption precondition holds, checked at the register: D-054, D-057 and D-048 are each ADOPTED with no OVERTURNED or SUPERSEDED marking. D-058 is likewise adopted, which the entry relies on for its own-cycle claim.

The attack 'bundled with D-058' fails four ways: the protocol line states 'This file is one owner-recording entry and one cycle'; the header states '**Does not** owner-record DR-002 or any other row'; a standalone line states 'Own cycle. D-058 already adopted at 21f0945 for DR-002. This file is D-059 only'; and clause 5 states 'Does not owner-record DR-002, DR-003, DR-005, or DR-008.'
The attack 'silent SATISFIED' fails: the header refuses it, clause 3 states 'Does not mark DR-004 SATISFIED', and the Readiness effect states 'Zero SATISFIED.'

The attacks 'file 08 edited' and 'condition 5 / docs/v2/implementation' fail: the header refuses both, clause 3 states 'Conditions 2–5 remain. Condition 5 remains the only implementation authorization', clause 4 states 'Does not edit file 08 (MF-6). A later cell note is a separate act', file 08 measures unchanged and git reports zero modified tracked files.

The dependency declaration is in the required form: 'Dependencies: D-054, D-057, and D-048. Revocation or overturn requires this owner's supersession and reconciliation of dependent MF-6 notes.' The owner role matches file 08's DR-004 cell, 'Evidence/retention authority'.

The rider statement is correct and reasoned: 'Operative riders: none. D-050 recorded ACCEPT 0/0 with no rider. No ACCEPT-WITH-ADVISORIES advisories to classify.' Right for this row, unlike DR-005 where D-039's RB-DR005-V2-A1 must travel.

Reversibility is the correct compound form and does not reach back into its authorities: 'Compound. Overturn: C-D059, plus reconciliation of any later MF-6 note. Does not overturn D-048, D-050, D-054, or D-057.'

Recorded because it closes a loop I opened: my note on the D-058 cycle warned that two frozen D-058 drafts had both received my CONSENT and that only one should be adopted, with the adopted entry citing the verdict written against the draft it adopts. 21f0945 adopted coordinator-decisions.D-058.draft.md citing coordinator-decisions.D-058.review-adversarial.claude2.json, which is the correct pairing. A duplicate register entry then appeared at 4dedc17 and was dropped at 1b94ad5, leaving exactly one D-058 heading in live COORD.

nonConsentNote: I do not CONSENT, on one SHOULD-FIX, and the entry is otherwise the cleanest owner recording in this family. The pin list is complete in the form D-057 requires, the Route A remainder is an exact match to the disposition's own field including the cross-row DR-002 AC-4 link, all five commits resolve, and it cites 21f0945 rather than the duplicate commit for D-058's adoption. My objection is narrow: the COORD pin fixes a register state that was committed in error at 4dedc17 and reverted at 1b94ad5, so it matches no live bytes. Re-measuring to 658c4d15 closes it. I also record that the duplicate-D-058 risk I flagged as a note last cycle did occur and was caught and corrected by the coordinator, which is the control working.
